text.en:
Upon exiting Void Empowerment, gain a <void/>Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence). 

The amount of Void Overshield granted is determined by how long you were empowered. 3 HP is granted for for each second that Empowerment lasted, capping at 40 HP for 13 seconds of Empowerment.
